english.title: Cause annoyance or offence to person / cause disruption - Birmingham International Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[behaved in such a way as to give reasonable cause for annoyance or offence to a person]_
(B)_[caused a disruption]_

at Birmingham International Airport
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 2.2 and 4.8.2 of the Birmingham Airport Limited Byelaws 2021.
